content: Juda nebere mora bagu Pol kot langa tafa tuwane.

Saini fati 5 usu wainga, pris mora bagu Ananaias wainga, Juda nebere mora ila bagu, Rom nebere nuuni beele isou fai ete unyi Tertulus, nere gaara Sisaria taon langa mane. Onodu nere Pol kot langa tafa tuwodbode beele waha gabman amugou letuwane.

Ono wanenga gabman amugou no Pol yaure tuwai, saini no mayainga, Tertulus no go langa beele ayawou hugu warai. No benou lewai, “Fai anyakaro Feliks, ne ere hilou yafa dewei nomo hoyo higene, warawou dada heigei uwa. Ne name ninate isou hilou langa, ne ere ebere gane hoyo nigidu dada baingaro amina inyi dewei uwa waha tiginimu wene.
Ere dada waha uredu, huwanyage hilobainga inyi ganga, ere ne hilobainga tigini hiniya.
“Gamaji ji saini ufaro yaasu hinoga. Ne ere bonahe aau naronga, ebere beele tutu mene beha isau ganga boni isoki hinoni ononi.

Ere fai beha ureya wa, no ou baingaro heigemugou fai. No Juda oruwanga ha-ha oruwa langa yafade waha nere gama la honggorowou jaimu bona oota jaimu jaimuna. Onodu fai nere waha ebere gane awa nigidu komowou fere heigemu wane, nere waha Nasaret nigide, no nebere mora bagu.

No Itou ago langa tempel fere jijigamuwei nomo onogai, ono gainga ere yaasu tuweye. Waha bona ne nage fai beha edo isoki tuwau, onodu dada oruwanga ere no kot langa tafa tuweye waha no nogo hurau langa isau ganga.”
Juda nere fere Tertulus nomo beele hoyodu Pol go bode beele benou lewane, “Beele beha oruwanga tigini.”
Pol no Feliks beele malalamudu letuwai.

Ono wanenga gabman amugou no Pol beele edo lewonbona waha abiti tuwou owo aya bona owo wenga letuwainga, Pol no beele ege gidu benou lewai, “Ji isini, haga orei baingaro ne fai-aita bagu beha nebere jas yafene. Onou waha bona ji ne langa beele gidu lewei nomo huwanyafe hilobainga inyina.
Ne kejiwe isoki nigei mata bonahe wonga, beele benou isau ganga, Ji amina fati 12 wahanga Jerusalem langa bori urei nomo manene.

Onodu Juda nere ji fai ete ngare tempel nomo orei huwanya langa beele la wara gerenga yeriyegu uwa. Nere ji fai-aita bagu nebere komowou bori mata huwanya langa, taon huwanya langa heigemu genenga yeriyegu uwa.
Onodu beele elebe nere ji kot langa tafa hiyane beha, wa tigini uwa. Nere nebere beele beha ngalenga yo, waha abitimuwei nomo jala uwau.

“Beele ngalenga waha benou. Jala ji oojo oojoni waha nere lede, ‘fai fereha nebere jala.’ Ji Jala waha oojo boni ebere asage gane nebere Itou unyi gai isouni. Ji beele oruwanga nuuni beele langa inyina bagu, beele oruwanga profet yeregane waha boni huwanyafe ngalengana.

Ji huwanyafe ngalenga ganga, Itou no fai hilou bagu fai inyaba bagu umeru wane waha, ege jaimu nigon bona waha itarini. Nere fere huwanyanege ngalengawai, waha bode Itou no onou ono wonbona waha itaride.
Onou waha boni saini oruwa ji Itou ago langa, nere fai-aita bagu agenege langa nyabuluwou uwau, huwanyafe tigini inyei nomo danga tafa tafani.

“Ji haga orei ila langa, ji matane ila langa yafene. Onodu iinga ji gidu boni yame ilibafe gane bagu mayene. Ji fai-aita bagu dada bode tutu nigai waha hoyo nigei nomo moni dada tamayene, ji eeya muru warou ila fere tamayene.

Ji tempel langa goyonboni, waha bona ji amugedu Itou ago la jijiga uwau heigei nomo fanyimu oojo wene, onodu goyene. Onodu saini ji tempel langa yafa genenga yeriyane wa, ji amina eege heigene. Onodu fai nere ji ngate gaara yafeye wa nere bainga uwa, nere fai walanga belenege otobode kejiwe hiri wegu uwa.
Ariya Juda ila nere Esia prowinsha, nere maidu ji yaasu hiyane. Nere fai waha ji bagu beele ila bagu wonga wa hilobainga, nere nage hogone belanga maidu bode ji bode kot wode.
Uwa wonga, nere fai beha nebere kaunsel langa oto ganenga ji nere langa beele malalamudu lewene, nere tigini le hinodbode, taate nyabuluwou nere ji langa toroba wane.

Ji beele etenga behanga lewene waha nere edega wegu uwa rute. Saini ji nere gama langa otoboni benou yaurene, ‘Ji benou huwanyafe ngalengana, nere fai ummane waha ege gidu jayodbode, hugu waha bode elebe nere tebere kot langa haifedu mayane.’”

Ariya Feliks no fai-aita bagu nere Anyakaro nomo Jala oojowei nomo nebere huwanyanege ngalengawou fanyinege bagu isi borodu, Feliks no Juda nere itariwei nomo lenigai. No benou lewai, “Saini ofisa amugou Lisias no monga, ji tebere beele beha tiginimu tagonboni.”
Onodu Feliks no kepten Pol dagou mata langa tafa tuwei nomo letuwai, ariya no haruwe danga bagu adai tuwou. No Pol ilibumu gane dada bode hoyo tuwei nomo adai karu nigou.
Feliks no Pol haga orei nga nononga dagou mata langa tafa tuwainga yafai.

Ariya fati ila goyainga, Feliks no oya Drusila ngare mayare. Drusila no Juda nebereha aita. Feliks no Pol yaure tudu bona no langa beele ila isai. Pol no Yesus Kristus bona huwanya ngalengawei nomo fanyimu bona letuwai.

Onodu Pol no onowou tigini, fai no nogo bona oofa dewonbona, Itou no ere iinga kot langa tafa higonbona waha lewai. Feliks no beele waha isidu bona umugai. Onodu letuwai, “Ne goyau. Iinga ji saini bagu wonga, ege yaure hinonboni.”

Ariya Feliks no dada ete bona fere itariwai. No ninau benou isai, Pol no awa tuwehenga malala goyei nomo bona gelele hiyou moni ila hiyona rute iwai. Waha bona saini baingaro no yaure tugainga mai gainga, no ngare beele haigare.
Saini haga orei nga usu wainga, Porsius Festus no Feliks nomo haumu tai. Ono wainga Feliks no Juda ono nigonga no bode edega wodbode waha bona, Pol awa tuwainga dagou mata langa yafai.
